purpose: Test whether natural-connection mechanisms observed in Scan 009 repeat across unrelated industries. Repeated mechanisms are discovery priors only; no route is promoted without a specific residual missing edge, paired pressure and actor-level truth.

evidence: Maichao Food adapts flavor, packaging and production standards by destination market.

Jinpeng feeds overseas ad/user response back to R&D and product support; Pakistan response changed product direction, while a Gabonese student employee participates in Africa sales and local marketing-company access.
A Xinyi made-to-measure apparel exporter produces destination/customer-specific products rather than one global standard item.
Xuzhou already has increasingly mature standard cross-border services covering platforms, logistics, ads, compliance, independent sites and public overseas warehouses.
findings.interpretation: The natural resource is a lawful, credible local-context sensor close enough to the target market to change a real decision. International students are only one possible carrier, alongside overseas customers, dealers, foreign employees, local marketing firms and local technicians.
findings.residual_question: Do smaller exporters have repeated bounded country-specific decisions that remain unresolved after standard providers and are currently handled by guessing, acquaintances, scattered customer messages or ad feedback?
findings.promotion_gate: At least two small-exporter primary actors must report the same-shaped unresolved decision, current workaround, real consequence and willingness to use/pay for bounded evidence. Do not pair a capability-side actor before this truth exists.

evidence: Pizhou shared laboratory: an underutilized leading-firm laboratory now serves nearby SMEs, with a participant reporting turnaround from about three days to half a day and roughly 70% lower testing cost.
Xuzhou reports a shared welding center involving 30+ SMEs.
A shared security-protection system serves 20+ SME digital firms in Quanshan and reportedly reduces data-security operating cost by about 40%.
Three years of chain collaboration reports 561 expert-team matches and 427 technical-attack agreements.
findings.interpretation: Shared capability now repeats across physical testing, welding, digital security and expert knowledge. It is an observed formation mechanism, not a new market thesis.
findings.residual_search_rule: Require both sides in the same workflow: callable surplus/underutilization and repeated measurable workaround cost. One-sided pain or one-sided idle capacity is insufficient.

evidence: Twelve Pizhou semiconductor-chain members formed internal-priority purchasing and coordinated bargaining.
A reported RMB 11+ million cleaning-equipment purchase achieved about 10% lower cost and more than RMB 1.1 million savings.
The same chain formed testing, intermediate-material reuse and clean-technology guidance cooperation; clean-technology guidance alone reportedly saves nearly RMB 1 million per year.
findings.interpretation: Demand itself can become a resource after aggregation. Do not create a generic group-buying thesis; scan for repeated small buyers separately purchasing the same expensive input and an organizer with real trust/rule authority.

evidence: XCMG reports 300+ overseas dealers, 2,000+ overseas service terminals, 50+ overseas subsidiaries and 10+ overseas plants.
XCMG trains overseas dealer/customer service personnel and local technicians so diagnostic and repair capability moves closer to installed equipment.
Its India training base trains local service personnel/customers and develops localized instructor/course certification.
Current overseas service roles explicitly train dealer service staff and feed service/spare-parts information back to China-side technical and marketing teams.
findings.interpretation: Capability localization is mature for large manufacturers. The only interesting residual is whether smaller exporters in the same destination/technical family already share dealer/repair/service nodes or still pay disproportionate travel/downtime costs.

evidence: A Xuzhou industrial cutting-tool remanufacturer reports tungsten/cobalt hard-alloy input prices rising from roughly RMB 300+/kg to about RMB 2,500/kg, increasing new-tool cost and making used-tool regrinding/remanufacture more valuable; first-quarter orders reportedly rose 50% quarter-on-quarter.
Xuzhou's engineering-machinery strategy explicitly develops remanufacturing, second-hand equipment circulation, global spare-parts dispatch and digital maintenance as lifecycle businesses.
A 2026 machinery-industry remanufacturing standard names XCMG-related institutions among its drafters.
findings.interpretation: Do not promote generic remanufacturing. Add a dynamic scan trigger: when material, energy, import, labor or disposal economics move sharply, re-evaluate assets/components previously below the recovery threshold.

evidence: Xuzhou reports nearly 1,000 registered cross-border e-commerce enterprises, five provincial cross-border parks and eleven public overseas warehouses.
Jiangsu's 2026-2028 plan expands public overseas warehouses and customs-clearance, returns, last-mile delivery and display functions.

ShaJi smaller exporters still report high irreversible capital, 4-6 month cash cycles, destination-specific selection differences and foreign-language/operations talent scarcity, responding by borrowing mature firms' routes or forming joint ventures with experienced cross-border firms.
findings.interpretation: Logistics, platform operations, returns and compliance are increasingly organized. Formation 014 must not drift into those markets; its surviving truth target is a pre-commit country-specific decision that the organized stack still does not answer economically.

evidence: Xuzhou's 2026 first scene release contains 50 opportunity scenes and 72 capability scenes; a July review reports 285 scene projects landed over roughly one year.
The mechanism is explicit: opportunity list quarterly, capability list monthly, with enterprise problem-setting, department platform-building and expert feasibility review.
Shared welding, healthcare-model deployment and multi-party scene alliances show an orchestrator can supply trust, rules, access and verification rather than merely list A/B resources.
findings.interpretation: The public scene system is an existing connection-former, not a market gap. The high-value sensor is its residue: unmatched, repeatedly re-scoped, timed-out, failed-acceptance or high-manual-translation cases. Public pages do not currently expose that status layer.
findings.next_truth: Obtain lawful aggregate or case-level residue from scene owners/participants; do not duplicate the existing scene-matching platform.
